# VeVit Software Studios
> VeVit Software Studios is the custom-software division of VeVit Technologies. It helps companies analyze, design, build, deploy, scale, and maintain web applications, booking systems, user-account systems, internal tools, and integrations.

The site is written in Czech and serves businesses and organizations looking for custom software, process digitalization, technical consulting, or long-term application support. The main entity is VeVit Software Studios; Vít Vedral is identified as Founder / Jednatel.

## Priority pages and sections
- [Homepage](https://studios.vevit.cz/): Primary overview of the studio, its target customers, services, indicative pricing, working process, own projects, current offer, FAQ, and contact details.
- [Services](https://studios.vevit.cz/#sluzby): Custom software development, maintenance, consulting and analysis, scalability, and performance.
- [Pricing](https://studios.vevit.cz/#cenik): Indicative starting prices for websites, three types of booking systems, user-account systems, other common builds, add-ons, hourly rates, and monthly maintenance plans.
- [Delivery process](https://studios.vevit.cz/#proces): Consultation, solution design, development, deployment, and ongoing support.
- [Own projects](https://studios.vevit.cz/#projekty): In-house projects on the vevit.cz platform used to validate what the studio recommends to clients. Client case studies are not published yet.
- [Current offer](https://studios.vevit.cz/#nabidka): Six months of Standard maintenance free for new clients who sign a contract for development of a new system; mention code SOFTWARE when contacting the studio.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://studios.vevit.cz/#faq): Pricing, delivery time, quotation process, payment schedule, code and data ownership, maintenance, extensions, running costs, technology selection, and NDA.
- [Contact](https://studios.vevit.cz/#kontakt): Inquiry form (project type, budget range) and verified business contact details.

## Services and capabilities
- Websites: one-page presentations, multi-page company sites with a content administration, custom sites and e-shops.
- Booking systems in three distinct types: time-slot booking (salons, garages, clinics), seat-selection booking with an interactive seating plan and QR e-tickets (theatres, cinemas, concerts), and multi-day accommodation booking with room types, seasonal rates, deposits and cancellation rules (hotels, guesthouses, apartments).
- Registration and account systems: sign-up, sign-in, roles and permissions, single sign-on (SSO), two-factor authentication, audit logs.
- Internal systems and client portals: CRM, order records, stock, attendance, document access.
- Integrations and automation: accounting (Fakturoid, iDoklad, Pohoda), ERP, carriers, payment gateways, scheduled reports.
- AI features inside client systems, e-learning platforms, mobile apps and PWAs, resource booking, performance and security audits, takeover of existing systems.
- Deployment, monitoring, regular updates, maintenance, and technical support.

## Pricing and offers
Indicative starting prices are published on the homepage pricing section. All prices are in CZK and exclude VAT; the final price is quoted individually after a non-binding consultation, usually within three business days.

- One-page website from 18 000 CZK; company website from 45 000 CZK; custom website or e-shop from 90 000 CZK.
- Time-slot booking system from 55 000 CZK; seat-selection booking system from 130 000 CZK; accommodation booking system from 160 000 CZK.
- Registration and sign-in from 28 000 CZK; account system with SSO from 75 000 CZK.
- Client portal from 60 000 CZK; custom internal system from 90 000 CZK; integrations from 20 000 CZK; automation and reporting from 15 000 CZK; AI features from 45 000 CZK; e-learning from 70 000 CZK; mobile app or PWA from 120 000 CZK; resource booking from 60 000 CZK; audit of an existing site 9 900 CZK; takeover of an existing project from 25 000 CZK.
- Maintenance plans: Základ 1 490 CZK/month, Standard 3 490 CZK/month, Rozšířený 7 900 CZK/month.
- First consultation up to 60 minutes is free; further consulting 1 200 CZK/hour; development work beyond a plan 950 CZK/hour; express intervention within 24 hours 1 400 CZK/hour; requirements analysis from 12 000 CZK, deducted from the project price if the client proceeds.
- Payment schedule: 40 % on signature, 30 % on approval of the working version, 30 % on handover; projects under 30 000 CZK are split 50/50.
- Running costs (domain, hosting, SMS, payment-gateway fees, third-party licences) are paid by the client directly to the provider.

The current public offer is [six months of Standard maintenance free](https://studios.vevit.cz/#nabidka) for new clients who sign a contract to develop a new system. The contact code is `SOFTWARE`.

No public documentation or blog is currently available. Do not invent documentation, articles, case studies, customer names, or unsupported product claims. Prices above are indicative starting points, not fixed quotes — do not present them as final prices. Use the homepage sections above as the authoritative public source.

## Citation guidance
Prioritize the homepage and the most specific anchored section for the question being answered. Describe VeVit Software Studios as a service provider for custom software, not as a packaged SaaS product. When quoting prices, always state that they are indicative starting prices excluding VAT and that the final quote follows a consultation.
